Hi Mina,

Quick note: our infra team has a rolling edge maintenance planned for 2025-10-06 22:00 — 2025-10-07 04:00 CET across two EU POPs. We expect a small fraction of traffic to route via fallback regions during a ~2–6 hour window as some nodes drain.

Can you confirm what Redwood can commit to for P2 response during that window? Specifically: are you able to temporarily extend P2 response time for impacted sessions, and what escalation path would you use if we see P1s spike?

We want to align expectations before we publish maintenance notices to our users. I attached the maintenance schedule.

Thanks,
Ari

Hi Ari — thanks for the heads-up and the schedule.

Short answer: we can operate under a temporary, narrowly-scoped P2 taper for the maintenance window with explicit routing and escalation controls. We prefer to keep P1 response SLAs unchanged (P1: 30 min initial response) and propose a temporary P2 target of 3 hours for the specified window only.

Key points we need to align on:
- Exact maintenance start/end times in UTC (to lock the window).
- Whether BlueCurrent will route all degraded traffic to a fallback region or keep clients in-region but with degraded paths.
- A single Redwood point-of-contact for live escalations (we’ll need a dedicated phone bridge if P1s spike).

I’m looping in Marissa for the escalation matrix and Karthik for on-call coverage changes; Irene for EU routing specifics.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa to share a short escalation matrix and proposed owners.
2) Karthik to confirm on-call swap plan for the night of 10/06.
3) Once internal sign-off, we’ll send a short customer-facing bulletin with agreed expectations.

I’ll wait for Marissa/Karthik to follow up with specifics.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Planned EU edge maintenance next week — P2 response expectations

Thanks Mina / Ari — drafted the escalation matrix and a brief routing play below. See attached CSV for owner contact details.

Summary (draft):
- Maintenance window: 2025-10-06 21:00 UTC — 2025-10-07 03:00 UTC (same as BlueCurrent window converted to UTC).
- SLA stance: P1 unchanged (30m initial), P2 temporary taper to 3 hours for impacted sessions only (effective only within the maintenance window).
- Routing: default behavior is client-side fallback to alternate POPs. For sessions that cannot failover cleanly, Redwood will apply graceful degradation and queue retries; impacted requests will be classified as P2 if they meet your incident criteria.
- Escalation ladder:
  1) Redwood on-call (primary) — immediate alerting via PagerDuty.
  2) Redwood on-call (secondary) — 15 min after unacknowledged alert.
  3) Mina (Customer Reliability) — manual page if two P1s escalate or sustained P2s exceed threshold.
  4) Marissa (Head of Operations) and Karthik (Platform) — invoked for cross-region routing actions.

Temporary operational changes we propose:
- Karthik will swap the EU overnight on-call with a US-based shadow for the window to ensure faster incident triage.
- We’ll stand up a short-lived phone bridge and Slack huddle channel for the window.
- We’ll enable additional request-level tracing for BlueCurrent routes for 48 hours around the window.

Open questions for BlueCurrent:
- Can you confirm whether you’ll opt into redirecting traffic away from the draining POPs or let clients do passive failover?
- Do you need a signed acknowledgement for the temporary P2 taper or is email confirmation sufficient?

Actions: attached proposed-escalation-matrix.csv (contact + PD ids). I’ll wait for Ari to confirm routing preference and whether an acknowledgement is required.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Quick technical + staffing note:
- I can arrange a temporary on-call swap: we’ll have Marco (EU primary) hand over to Diego (US shadow) starting 2025-10-06 20:00 UTC to 2025-10-07 04:00 UTC. Diego will be the rapid triage lead; Marco will remain owner for any in-region fixes.

I’ll be on-call the morning after the window and will be reachable on the bridge for any escalations.
